title: For instance display names that (1) are not deleted and are running on host
question: For instance display names that (1) are not deleted and are running on host 'blaze8-12' with extra metadata present, and (2) have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and a display name matching the pattern 'prime' across migrations, show the host-level variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) along with the migration-level variance of instance memory (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH QualifyingInstances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    i.UUID AS instance_uuid,
    i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb
  FROM `instances` AS i
  JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie
    ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID
  JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism
    ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID
  WHERE i.DELETED = 0
    AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'
    AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type'
    AND i.DISPLAY_NAME LIKE '%prime%'
),
HostStats AS (
  SELECT
    VARIANCE(qi.memory_mb) AS host_memory_mb_variance,
    STDDEV(qi.memory_mb) AS host_memory_mb_stddev
  FROM QualifyingInstances AS qi
),
MigrationStats AS (
  SELECT
    m.ID AS migration_id,
    VARIANCE(qi.memory_mb) AS migration_memory_mb_variance
  FROM `migrations` AS m
  JOIN QualifyingInstances AS qi
    ON qi.instance_uuid = m.INSTANCE_UUID
  GROUP BY m.ID
)
SELECT
  hs.host_memory_mb_variance,
  hs.host_memory_mb_stddev,
  ms.migration_id,
  ms.migration_memory_mb_variance
FROM HostStats AS hs
CROSS JOIN MigrationStats AS ms
ORDER BY ms.migration_id

WITH QualifyingInstances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    i.UUID AS instance_uuid,
    i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb
  FROM `instances` AS i
  JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie
    ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID
  JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism
    ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID
  WHERE i.DELETED = 0
    AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'
    AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type'
    AND i.DISPLAY_NAME LIKE '%prime%'
),
HostStats AS (
  SELECT
    VARIANCE(qi.memory_mb) AS host_memory_mb_variance,
    STDDEV(qi.memory_mb) AS host_memory_mb_stddev
  FROM QualifyingInstances AS qi
),
MigrationStats AS (
  SELECT
    m.ID AS migration_id,
    VARIANCE(qi.memory_mb) AS migration_memory_mb_variance
  FROM `migrations` AS m
  JOIN QualifyingInstances AS qi
    ON qi.instance_uuid = m.INSTANCE_UUID
  GROUP BY m.ID
)
SELECT
  hs.host_memory_mb_variance,
  hs.host_memory_mb_stddev,
  ms.migration_id,
  ms.migration_memory_mb_variance
FROM HostStats AS hs
CROSS JOIN MigrationStats AS ms
ORDER BY ms.migration_id

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT
  VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS host_variance,
  STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS host_stddev,
  VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS migration_variance
FROM instances i
JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid
JOIN instance_system_metadata sm ON sm.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND sm.`key` = 'image_image_type'
JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
WHERE i.deleted = 0
  AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
  AND i.display_name LIKE '%prime%';
